structured.feedback: The description is about 230 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the stiffness complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the unsupported "adjustable" tie lengths, and the "hand wash only" note, which some would read as a weakness.
